messages:
sophie_partnerships: Quick note  we had a partner open three separate SEVs across their tools last night and our teams scrambled to reconcile. We need a tiny deterministic path for partner-originated SEVs.

mike_oncall: Absolutely. Proposal: one shared first-hop channel + a single bot command that creates a private bridge + injects a minimal triage template.

dilara_partner_se: From partner ops: we'll only integrate to stable channel names. Can we pick a canonical first-hop like #partner-first-hop and require the first message include ORG=<org> CASE=<id>? That lets our automation dedupe.

oscar_sre: Operational behavior: when a message in #partner-first-hop contains ORG= and CASE= the bot should: 1) create private warroom #pw-<org>-<case>, 2) ping both orgs' oncall, 3) post triage gist + one-line public status snippet.

bridge_bot: Trigger matched: ORG=acme CASE=7890. Created channel #pw-acme-7890. Zoom: https://meet.redwood/pw-7890. Notifying @mike_oncall, @dilara_partner_se. Triage template posted. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/partners/sev-path

mike_oncall: Triage template (bot-inserted):
Impact: (prod/infra)
Case ID:
Org:
Symptoms & first-seen: 
Mitigations tried: 
Owner (org:user): 
Relay contact (partner email): 
Escalation TTL (default 10m, partner override allowed)
Public status blurb (one line):

dilara_partner_se: We'll require the relay contact line. Also we need the bot to emit a short JSON-safe artifact location (S3 link or SSO-safe path) so we can drop logs without exposing our internal trackers.
oscar_sre: Agreed. Add a handback checklist that the bot will auto-fill when resolved: resolution timestamp, remediation summary (1-2 lines), artifacts left (links), SI validation rows, and a closure confirmation line the SI must post.

sophie_partnerships: Process ladder idea: 1) Partner posts in #partner-first-hop with ORG/CASE + short impact. 2) Bot creates bridge and posts triage. 3) Owner declared within TTL or default claim by oncall. 4) 10-min checkpoints until resolved; on resolve, bot publishes handback envelope.

mike_oncall: Small tweak: default TTL 10m, escalate to SRE lead at 30m, exec notify at 90m. Allow partner to request longer TTL for complex integrations.

dilara_partner_se: We'll run a 20-minute drill with our ops team once you push the bot change. Also can you provide a copy-pasteable public status template we can use on our status page?
oscar_sre: I'll add the public-status snippet to the bot payload. Next actions: Oscar to PR bot change (ETA 48h), Dilara to share relay-email format and status page template (ETA 48h), Mike to update oncall doc with the new default TTLs (ETA EOW), Sophie to circulate the one-pager and run the first drill (ETA next week).

bridge_bot: Reminder set: "Partner SEV drill: acme" in 7 days.

sophie_partnerships: Thanks all. Goal is minimal friction + single source-of-truth so partners and Redwood stop duplicating effort. If you see edge cases (multi-org account links, delegated SIs), post them here and I'll fold them into the one-pager.
